title: Rock Solid Warriors
description: This mod adds a whole new side of Minecraft, adding rocks that you shoot fire out of! You and your friends can have an epic battle to the end with Rock Solid Warriors, ha see what I did!
body:
**Rock Solid Warriors** - **Rising Heros**:

**Version 0.00**

Rock Solid Warriors is a mod that adds fire shooting rocks to improve replayability to minecraft. Rock Solid Warriors allows you to play with friends and battle with ranged weopons rather than just swords.
